structure_policy_rationale: 抖音的原始图标本身就是高度抽象的几何符号（音符），符合 theme_design_analysis 中‘保留清晰几何符号’的条件。参考案例中 douyin 也是保留了音符拓扑结构。因此必须严格保留其主体轮廓和空间布局，仅对填充色、描边和质感进行主题化重构，严禁改变其基本形态。
preserve: 音符的整体S形曲线走向
左下方的圆形符头位置与大小比例
右上方的符尾旗帜形状及角度
must_preserve: 音符的标准轮廓拓扑结构
粗犷的黑色/深色手绘描边
高饱和度的主题红色（砖红/朱红）作为主填充色
recompose_allowed: 移除原有的青色/蓝色重影故障效果
将平滑矢量边缘替换为抖动、圆润的手绘边缘
在符头内部添加简单的黄色或蓝色四角星装饰
调整填充色为纯色块，去除任何渐变
restyle: 应用复古手绘涂鸦风格（Retro Hand-drawn Doodle）
模拟蜡笔或马克笔的粗糙笔触质感
采用扁平化设计，完全摒弃立体光影
decorate: 在音符头部嵌入一个小型的四角星或圆点作为点睛之笔
保持构图居中，四周留黑均匀
forbid: 保留原有的青色（Cyan）和故障风双色错位效果
使用细线条、无描边或平滑工业感线条
添加立体阴影、高光、环境光遮蔽或渐变效果
将音符变形为相机、播放键或其他非音符物体
使用主题色板之外的颜色（如亮粉色、紫色、绿色）
generation_brief: A retro hand-drawn doodle style icon of the Douyin musical note shape. Centered on a pure black background. The note is filled with solid brick red (no gradients). It has a heavy, rough, uneven black marker outline. Inside the round head of the note, include a small simple yellow four-pointed star. Flat, naive, clumsy aesthetic, high contrast, crayon texture.
color_application: Map the original white/glitch colors to the theme's limited palette: use solid Brick Red for the main body fill. Use Yellow or Deep Blue only for small internal decorative elements (like the star). Strictly no Cyan/Magenta glitch effects.
stroke_application: Apply a thick, rough, hand-drawn black outline around the entire musical note shape. The line should have uneven thickness and jittery edges, simulating a dry marker or crayon stroke. No smooth vector lines.
composition_application: Center the simplified musical note symbol in the canvas. Ensure it occupies about 60-70% of the visual weight. Maintain uniform black negative space around the subject. Remove all background elements.
identity_application: Preserve the exact topological structure of the musical note (flag tail and round head) to ensure immediate recognition. Replace the modern 'glitch' identity with a 'naive/clumsy' identity while keeping the core shape intact.
fidelity_constraints: Must have thick, rough hand-drawn black outlines
Colors must be flat, high-saturation primary/theme colors (Red/Yellow/Blue)
No gradients, shadows, or 3D effects allowed
Subject must be a simplified geometric block combination
negative_constraints: No clean vector lines or perfect symmetry
